Package io.webagent4j.policy.network

Interface INetworkAddressResolver

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface INetworkAddressResolver
Resolves a hostname to the addresses it currently maps to. Injectable so tests can supply deterministic, fake DNS results instead of ever performing a real lookup.

Contract: one call to resolve(String) performs at most one resolution attempt - no hidden retry loop. A transient failure must be surfaced as a thrown UnknownHostException (or another RuntimeException), never silently retried or converted into an empty result.
